description_en: Encrypts an original phone number into a virtual phone number that starts with 140. By integrating with Alibaba Cloud communication services, you can use the encrypted 140 phone number to initiate voice calls, achieving the effect of a virtual phone number call
description_zh: 将原始号码加密为一个140开头的虚拟号码。通过结合阿里云的通信服务，可以使用加密后的140号码发起语音呼叫。实现虚拟号码呼叫的效果
name: PhoneNumberEncrypt

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

On the My Applications page of the Cell Phone Number Service console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

在号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)我的申请页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en:
The phone number to be queried.

Currently, only single phone number queries are supported
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的号码。

目前仅支持单个号码查询
parameters.name: input_number

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method of the phone number. Valid value: NORMAL.


<notice>Currently, only the NORMAL encryption method is supported.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
号码的加密方式。取值：NORMAL。


<notice>目前仅支持NORMAL加密方式。></notice>
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en: The user-defined outId. This parameter is optional. The format is not limited, and the length must be less than or equal to 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定的outId，选填，格式不限，长度小于等于64
parameters.name: out_id
